ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, CD is the altitude from C to the hypotenuse AB, $BC=\sqrt{7}$, and $AC=3$. What is the value of $\sin\angle ACD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\triangle ABC$, where $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore AB = \sqrt{3^2 + (\sqrt{7})^2} = 4$,\\
$\angle ACD + \angle BCD = 90^\circ$,\\
$\because CD$ is the height from the hypotenuse $AB$,\\
$\therefore CD \perp AB$,\\
$\therefore \angle B + \angle BCD = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle ACD = \angle B$,\\
$\therefore \sin \angle ACD = \sin \angle B = \frac{AC}{AB} = \boxed{\frac{3}{4}}$

$\therefore \angle ACD = \angle B$,\\
$\therefore \sin \angle ACD = \sin \angle B = \frac{AC}{AB} = \boxed{\frac{3}{4}}$
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, CD is the altitude from C to the hypotenuse AB, $BC=\sqrt{7}$, and $AC=3$. What is the value of $\sin\angle ACD$?
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Given $\triangle ABC$, where $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$,\\ $\therefore AB = \sqrt{3^2 + (\sqrt{7})^2} = 4$,\\ $\angle ACD + \angle BCD = 90^\circ$,\\ $\because CD$ is the height from the hypotenuse $AB$,\\ $\therefore CD \perp AB$,\\ $\therefore \angle B + \angle BCD = 90^\circ$,\\ $\therefore \angle ACD = \angle B$,\\ $\therefore \sin \angle ACD = \sin \angle B = \frac{AC}{AB} = \boxed{\frac{3}{4}}$
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure is a triangle ABC, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is above, and ∠ACB is marked with a right angle; from C draw a perpendicular to the base AB, the foot of the perpendicular is D, so CD is the altitude on AB, and there is also a right-angle mark at D.

Then reason: It is known that AC=3, BC=√7, and ∠ACB=90°, so by the Pythagorean theorem AB=√(3^2+(√7)^2)=√16=4 can be obtained. Because CD⊥AB, in triangle BCD, ∠BCD and ∠B are complementary; also because ∠ACB=90°, ∠ACD and ∠BCD are complementary, therefore ∠ACD=∠B. Thus sin∠ACD=sin∠B. In right triangle ABC, sin∠B=opposite side/hypotenuse=AC/AB=3/4. Therefore the required value is 3/4.
